interface.name: rustyos_liquid_glass_manager_v1

description.summary: Liquid Glass backdrop blur and frosted glass decoration manager

interface.description: Factory interface for creating liquid glass surface decorators. Allows clients to request real-time compositor-side GPU frosted glass effects behind their surfaces or designated subregions.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Informs the compositor that the client will no longer use the rustyos_liquid_glass_manager_v1 object.

request.name: get_surface_glass

description.summary: create a liquid glass decorator for a wl_surface

request.description: Instantiate a rustyos_surface_glass_v1 decoration object associated with the specified wl_surface.

arg.name: surface
arg.summary: the surface to apply glass effects to

interface.name: rustyos_surface_glass_v1

description.summary: liquid glass decoration for a wl_surface

interface.description: Controls the optical backdrop blur, corner radius, vibrant tint, and clipping region for a wl_surface. State changes are double-buffered and take effect on the next wl_surface.commit.

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: liquid glass already exists for this surface

enum.name: style

description.summary: pre-configured optical style presets for RustyOS Liquid Glass

enum.description: Style presets dictate backdrop blur strength, saturation boost, specular border highlights, and chromatic transmission.

entry.name: popover
entry.summary: High vibrancy menu/popover glass (14px corner radius default, saturated backdrop)

entry.name: sidebar
entry.summary: Subtle translucent sidebar glass (12px corner radius, high diffusion blur)

entry.name: control_pill
entry.summary: Compact segmented pill glass (fully rounded capsule)

entry.name: base_panel
entry.summary: Top bar or dock base panel glass

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroys the decorator object. Any active glass effect on the surface is removed on the next wl_surface.commit.

request.name: set_region

description.summary: specify subregion where glass effect is rendered

request.description: Sets the region of the surface where the liquid glass backdrop should be drawn. Passing a null wl_region indicates that the entire surface bounds should receive the glass effect.

arg.name: region
arg.summary: bounding region or null for full surface

request.name: set_corner_radius

description.summary: set the rounded corner radius for the glass panel

request.description: Specifies the physical corner radius in surface-local pixels.

request.name: set_style

description.summary: set the optical glass style preset

request.description: Selects one of the predefined optical styles from the style enum.

request.name: set_tint
request.description: Sets an optional tint color (RGBA 0..255) overlay on the frosted glass.

request.name: commit

description.summary: explicit commit marker for glass state

request.description: Signals that all pending glass attributes have been configured. Pending changes are applied atomically on wl_surface.commit.
